name: Seaside

dates.built: Land inherited 1978; construction from 1981; plan complete c. 1985
dates.note: The node: 'land assembled 1978, construction begun 1981'; Wikipedia: 'In 1978, Davis inherited the parcel from his grandfather' and 'The final plan was complete around 1985'; DPZ's project page prints '1982 Broke Ground'. The node's 1981 and DPZ's 1982 disagree by a year and neither is changed.

refs.note: 'As Seaside is privately owned, no other municipal governments had planning jurisdiction over Seaside, and therefore the developers were able to write their own zoning codes.'
